title: Mexican Yeast Sopes
description: Soft, fluffy sopes topped with a light and airy yeast dough, perfect for a quick and easy Mexican-inspired meal.
instructions: Combine flour, Mexican yeast, and salt in a large bowl.
Gradually add water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, shape into balls, and flatten slightly.
Cook the sopes for 1-2 minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
Brush the sopes with vegetable oil and top with a spoonful of zesty salsa, shredded cheese, and any other desired toppings.
